svg.aria-label: dingding: a personal agent. A hooded keeper with a glowing staff guards a stone gate between a lit tower and a distant city in the clouds; letters, calendar pages, notes and parcels pass with their secrets blacked out, sealed scrolls stay behind.

g.font-family: Georgia, 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: a personal agent that guards what’s yours
